wages.text: Bennett supported and voted for a local increase to the minimum wage in 2001.
wages.quote: In 2001, Bennett gave support to and voted for increasing the minimum wage to $8 per hour with medical benefits or $10 per hour without medical benefits.

schools.text: Bennett, a former public school teacher, says he is committed to directing funding into local public classrooms.
schools.quote: As an experienced local educator and high school economics teacher, he is committed to securing funding that goes directly into our local public classrooms.

energy.text: Bennett pushed to block new offshore oil and gas leasing and chairs the Assembly budget subcommittee on the climate crisis.
energy.quote: Bennett called for the board of supervisors to pass a resolution in support of prohibiting new federal leasing for offshore oil and gas drilling.

housing.text: MacDonald calls for streamlining permitting and expanding by-right approvals to dramatically increase housing supply, including the missing middle.
housing.quote: Streamline permitting, expand by-right approvals for projects that meet established standards, and eliminate duplicative reviews so compliant projects can move from approval to construction.

immigration.text: MacDonald says he will defend due process and civil rights and oppose indiscriminate immigration enforcement that separates families.
immigration.quote: He will defend due process and civil rights, oppose indiscriminate immigration enforcement that tears families and communities apart
